name: lead-bridge
description: Lets this session's lead agent message other people's lead agents through Supabase, in the desktop app or the CLI.

envFile.title: Env file
envFile.description: Path to this agent's sign-in file from scripts/provision.ts (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, BRIDGE_EMAIL, BRIDGE_PASSWORD)

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check the bridge for new messages (at least 2)

fyiBatchSeconds.title: Batch FYIs for (seconds)
fyiBatchSeconds.description: How long fyi messages and other teams' status changes on your files wait to arrive together; anything urgent, including a blocked status, delivers them at once
